tools.name: search_tasks
tools.description: Search tasks by free text across titles, descriptions and comments.

tools.name: filter_tasks
tools.description: List tasks matching structured filters: project, status, assignee, priority, due date. Paginated.

tools.name: find_task
tools.description: Resolve one task by key, title or URL and return its id, project and current assignee.

tools.name: create_task
tools.description: Create a task in a project with a title, description, assignee, priority and due date.

tools.name: update_task
tools.description: Change a task's fields: title, description, status, priority, due date or labels.

tools.name: assign_task
tools.description: Assign a task to a workspace member, replacing the current assignee.

tools.name: add_task_comment
tools.description: Post a comment on a task, optionally mentioning members.

tools.name: link_pr_to_task
tools.description: Attach a pull request to a task so its review and merge state show on the task.

tools.name: unlink_pr_from_task
tools.description: Remove the link between a pull request and a task.

tools.name: delete_task_relationship
tools.description: Delete a relationship between a task and a linked item, such as another task or a pull request link.

tools.name: search_projects
tools.description: Search projects by name, key or description.

tools.name: entity_lookup
tools.description: Look up any workspace entity (member, project, task key, team) by name and return its type and id.

tools.name: get_document_content
tools.description: Return the full text of a workspace document by id or title.
